s: The US should take an active role in world affairs, even if it's costly and risks war.
I lean toward the US taking an active role in the world.
I lean toward the US focusing on problems at home.
The US should focus at home and stay out of other countries' affairs, even if rivals gain influence.
engagement_tradeoff.torn: I weigh an active role abroad and focusing at home about equally.

s: The US should work through alliances and agreements, even if that means compromising sometimes.
I lean toward working with allies.
I lean toward the US acting on its own when needed.
The US should act on its own to pursue its interests, even if allies object.
allies_tradeoff.torn: I weigh working with allies and acting alone about equally.

ally_attacked: If a treaty ally like a NATO member is attacked, the US should send troops to help defend it.
The US should send weapons and money to an attacked ally, but not troops.
The US should sanction the attacker and send humanitarian aid, but not weapons or troops.
The US should stay out of it, even when a treaty ally is attacked.
nato: The US should stay in NATO and strengthen its commitment.
The US should stay in NATO, but require allies to spend much more on defense.
The US should stay in NATO, but bring some of its forces home from Europe.
The US should leave NATO and bring its forces home from Europe.
defense_spending: Military spending should be cut by a quarter or more.
Military spending should be cut somewhat.
Military spending should stay about the same.
Military spending should go up somewhat.
Military spending should go up a lot.
troops_abroad: Most US troops at bases in countries like Germany, Japan and South Korea should come home.
US troops abroad should be reduced gradually.
US troops abroad should stay at about today's level.
The US should station more troops abroad.
use_force_cases: I'd oppose using US military force for this: {case}.
I'd support using US military force for this: {case}.
foreign_aid_level: US economic, health and humanitarian aid abroad should go up a lot.
US foreign aid should go up somewhat.
US foreign aid should stay about the same.
US foreign aid should be cut somewhat.
Most US foreign aid should end.
global_health_aid: US funding to fight diseases like HIV and malaria abroad should go up.
US funding for global health programs should stay about the same.
US funding for global health programs should go down.
The US should stop funding global health programs; that's for other countries to handle.
israel_military_aid: The US should give Israel military aid without conditions.
The US should give Israel military aid, with conditions on how weapons are used.
The US should give Israel only defensive military aid, like missile defense.
The US shouldn't give Israel military aid.
palestinian_state: The US should push hard now for an independent Palestinian state alongside Israel.
The US should support a Palestinian state, but only after a negotiated peace with security guarantees for Israel.
The US shouldn't support creating a Palestinian state.
ukraine_support: The US should send more military aid to help Ukraine win back its territory.
The US should give Ukraine enough aid to defend itself while pushing for talks.
The US should end most aid and press Ukraine to accept a settlement.
The US should end all aid to Ukraine and stay out.
taiwan_defense: If China invaded Taiwan, the US should stay out.
If China invaded Taiwan, the US should impose sanctions on China, and do nothing more.
If China invaded Taiwan, the US should send weapons and impose sanctions, but not troops.
If China invaded Taiwan, the US should send its own forces to defend Taiwan.
china_posture: The US should cooperate with China on shared problems and avoid confrontation.
The US should compete with China economically, but keep talking and cooperate where possible.
The US should treat China as its main adversary and confront it on every front.
united_nations: The UN should get more power and funding from the US.
The US should stay in the UN and pay its full share.
The US should stay in the UN, but cut funding and take part less.
The US should leave the UN.
international_courts: The US should join the International Criminal Court and accept its authority, including over Americans.
The US should cooperate with the court case by case, without joining.
The US shouldn't join or cooperate with the International Criminal Court.
The US shouldn't join, and should punish the court when it targets Americans or US allies.

s: The US should press countries on human rights, even if it hurts trade or security ties.
I lean toward pressing countries on human rights.
I lean toward working with countries when it serves US interests.
The US should work with countries when it serves US interests, whatever their human rights record.
human_rights_tradeoff.torn: I weigh human rights and US interests about equally.

nuclear_arms_control: The US should negotiate with Russia and China for sharp nuclear cuts, aiming eventually for none.
The US should negotiate mutual limits while keeping a strong nuclear arsenal.
The US shouldn't negotiate limits; it should build up its nuclear forces without limits.
national_service: Service should stay fully voluntary for young Americans.
Service shouldn't be required, but should come with strong rewards like college aid.
Every young American should have to do a year of military or civilian service.
Every young American should have to do military service.
strikes_on_terrorists: The US should never use drone strikes against terrorist leaders in other countries.
The US should use drone strikes against terrorist leaders only with the other country's permission.
The US should strike terrorist leaders wherever they are, with or without permission.
arms_sales: The US shouldn't let companies sell weapons to any other country.
The US should allow weapons sales only to close allies that are democracies.
The US should allow weapons sales to friendly countries, except those with poor human rights records.
The US should allow weapons sales to any friendly government.
iran_nuclear: If Iran moved to build a nuclear weapon, the US should negotiate and accept some risk.
The US should negotiate, backed by tough sanctions, but not strike.
The US should strike Iran's nuclear sites if talks fail.
The US should strike Iran's nuclear sites right away.
acquire_territory: The US shouldn't try to gain new territory like Greenland.
The US should gain new territory only if the people living there vote for it.
The US should try to buy or negotiate for new territory, even if the people there object.
The US should gain new territory by any means, including economic or military pressure.
